$ETH is going to the moon. The utility is something that separates it from other cryptos out there. $DOGE essentially has no value because it's a worse version of Bitcoin as a store of value. Ethereum had the foresight to allow developers to build apps on the blockchain

@jacksondutton_ @elonmusk They’re two different assets that are targeting different people. One is a store of value; the other is a currency. Elon is heavy on $doge, which could be more comparable to Ethereum if a hard fork turns $doge into a database for building apps as well (Dapps).

@BillyM2k @davidgokhshtein Yep. I believe you can already execute $DOGE transactions between accounts on top of Ethereum. A merger would likely be taking the miners from DOGE and bringing them to Ethereum to increase transaction speeds. Pay them in $ETH to move to a PoS verification model.

@davidgokhshtein You could run $DOGE or execute $DOGE transactions on top of Ethereum anyway. A combination of the two would likely only be related to creating additional verification nodes as Ethereum moves to version 2.0. The $DOGE currency would die obviously.
